name: XTUSD
oneLiner: XTUSD is XT.com/XSC's MakerDAO-style vault dollar, minted against overcollateralized XTDao crypto vaults with limited public on-chain tooling for Pharos.
collateral: Overcollateralized XTDao vault collateral on XSC; issuer materials describe XT as the initial collateral asset with protocol support for additional collateral over time, but public live collateral composition remains hard to verify without XSC tooling.
pegMechanism: XTDao CDP: users mint XTUSD against overcollateralized vaults; risky vaults are auctioned to keep collateral above outstanding debt. Secondary market and account liquidity run through XT.com, and Pharos does not model a fiat cash redemption window.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: GPT SOL-NR-A wave6; Kimi T53 archetype re-verification
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: XT.COM describes XTUSD as an XTDao vault system in which users mint debt against overcollateralized assets and unsafe vaults are auctioned. Those borrower-vault and liquidation mechanics establish the cdp archetype even though the current live collateral and control graph remain opaque. 2026-07-30 re-verification: at XSC block 47,929,909 the live MakerDAO DSS-style system is unchanged — the XTUSD token 0x1a6131ea… still has the DaiJoin 0xa57cde05… as its ward (wards = 1) and the Vat 0xf9d4810f… still returns live() = 1, so the borrower-vault mint path that grounds the cdp classification remains the live stabilization structure. A fresh v9 baseline replay compiles archetype = cdp with no missing-archetype gap.

oracleRisk.summary: The live XTUSD Vat 0xf9d4810f1b140d869d2f92ca8da1755ea55e786b on XSC carries a single debt-bearing ilk, XT-A (Wrapped XT collateral), with Vat.spot set to 3.4780667 ray at block 48187434 (2026-08-08), but no Spotter, pip, or other price-update contract is a current Vat ward: only the Jug and the XT-A GemJoin are authorized among probed system contracts, and neither exposes a spot-poke path, so the collateral-price path is opaque and has no identified on-chain update mechanism. The Median/OSM/Spotter stack observed on XSC is wired only to the legacy TAI deployment (token 0x775c4bc7…), not to the XTUSD token 0x1a6131ea… or the live Vat, and the issuer announcement names no feed, heartbeat, or failover. No Cat/Dog, auction, or global-settlement module is authorized on the live Vat either, so the announced auction-based liquidation is not operable on-chain at the reviewed block.

branchApplicability.rationale: XTUSD is a live CDP: the XSC Vat holds one debt-bearing ilk, XT-A (Art 4,325,685.43 XTUSD at block 48187434), so a liquidation branch exists and must be populated. Exactly one branch was identified: XT-A is the only ilk observed with debt across four years of system transactions and the only collateral adapter found (GemJoin 0xdec7d8fe…, WXT). The branch inventory rests on probing every contract visible in the system's transaction history; DSS ilks and wards cannot be enumerated by direct reads, so a never-used ilk or ward granted at setup cannot be excluded, hence confidence limited.

branches.label: XT-A vault ilk (Wrapped XT)
branches.summary: XT-A is the sole identified collateral branch: 4,325,685.43 XTUSD of vault debt (Art) against WXT at block 48187434 (2026-08-08). The Vat's XT-A spot is 3.4780667 ray, but no current Vat ward can update it and no liquidation module is authorized to act on unsafe vaults. The issuer's 2022 announcement publishes a 150% minimum collateral ratio and 3% annual fee for XT-A — the Jug duty reads 1.0000000009373033 ray, 3.0000% annualized, matching the announcement — but the mat/liquidation ratio is not readable on-chain because no Spotter holding it is wired to the live Vat.

feeds.provider: None identified: the XT-A collateral price is a static Vat.spot with no authorized updater
feeds.path: Vat 0xf9d4810f1b140d869d2f92ca8da1755ea55e786b ilks("XT-A").spot returns 3.478066666666666666666666666 ray, byte-identical on datarpc1 and datarpc2 at block 48211240 (2026-08-09) and unchanged from the block-48187434 read of 2026-08-08. No Spotter, pip, OSM, or median contract is a Vat ward: wards() answers 1 only for the Jug 0x8276a38e484771ee1b14c60aaa85ab2147e5eb0b and the XT-A GemJoin 0xdec7d8fe3955ccbeb009e366c583fba2a9b63d2e, and 0 for the DaiJoin 0xa57cde0585010aa1bcfadb3bf6f3445349bb98ab, the vow 0x73c190d6be81bbe3cbe96bb83d8ab66f1c645160, the CDP manager 0x5611e8f241a6fd545b642dff90c6ad8c68f89b99, the deployer 0xE8864ba6b3A6e2f5104A0ECFFd90E2C9fd2cb4Dc, and WXT 0x4b681a704664ce482c45ec16ac9ecc9b121fb037. Neither ward exposes a spot-poke path, and the Median-OSM-Spotter stack deployed on XSC is wired to the legacy TAI token 0x775c4bc7…, not to XTUSD or this Vat. Not-published: feed provider, feed address, heartbeat, staleness bound, and failover for the live path.

branches.fallbackBehavior: No oracle feed is identifiable on the live path. Among all probed system contracts (deployer, DaiJoin, CDP manager, Jug, GemJoin), only the Jug and the XT-A GemJoin are Vat wards at block 48187434, and neither exposes a file/poke that can update Vat.spot, so the XT-A spot of 3.4780667 ray has no identified on-chain update mechanism, no heartbeat, and no staleness rejection. The Median→OSM→Spotter stack visible on XSC is wired only to the legacy TAI deployment (token 0x775c4bc7…), not to the XTUSD token 0x1a6131ea… or the live Vat, and the issuer announcement names no oracle provider, feed address, heartbeat, or failover. Not-published: any feed identity or failover for the live path.

collateralParameters.note: The 150% minimum collateral ratio and 3% annual fee come from the issuer's 2022 launch announcement, not from a live Spotter read — the live Vat has no Spotter ward, so mat is not readable on-chain (the Jug duty independently matches 3.0000% annualized at block 48187434). Live Vat ilk XT-A parameters, re-read on two independent XSC RPCs (datarpc1, datarpc2) at block 48187434: line 1,000,000,000 XTUSD (1e54 rad), dust 10 XTUSD (1e46 rad), spot 3.4780667 ray, rate 1.1097688381727833 ray, Art 4,325,685.429106 — Vat-internal debt Art×rate = 4,800,510.89 XTUSD against a global Line of 2,000,000,000 XTUSD, so the ilk ceiling matches the announced 1,000,000,000 XTUSD design and is not breached. debtSharePct 100 rests on XT-A being the only debt-bearing ilk observed across four years of system transactions; DSS ilks cannot be enumerated by direct reads.

branches.liquidationMechanism: The issuer announcement describes an auction mechanism that handles risky vaults, but no liquidation module (Maker-style Cat/Dog or Flip/Clip auction contract) is a current Vat ward at block 48187434 — only the Jug and the XT-A GemJoin are authorized, and vault collateral seizure (Vat.grab) requires Vat auth — so no on-chain liquidation path is operable on the live deployment. No liquidation timer, grace period, or auction window stands on that path either, because no module exists to start one: liquidationDelaySec 0 records the absence of a delay parameter, not an ability to liquidate promptly. Not-published: liquidation trigger conditions and auction parameters.
branches.backstop: The Jug's vow() resolves to 0x73c190d6be81bbe3cbe96bb83d8ab66f1c645160, so Vat-internal surplus/debt accounting exists, but no flapper/flopper auction pair, stability pool, insurance fund, or committed bad-debt buyer was identified among authorized contracts, and the issuer publishes none. Not-published: any auction-based or fund-based liquidation backstop.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Vat.live() = 1 at block 48187434 and no global-settlement (End-like) module is authorized on the live Vat; the issuer publishes no shutdown, settlement, write-off, or bad-debt socialization procedure, and with no operable liquidation module an undercollateralized vault has no identified on-chain resolution path. Not-published: shutdown and bad-debt handling.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice); R13 re-open
reserveReview.rationale: The first-party announcement describes XT as the initial XTDao collateral asset and says additional collateral may be supported later, but it is a 2022 launch announcement rather than a current reserve inventory. A 2026-07-20 re-review found no current collateral weights, custody evidence, or XSC-readable reserve state. The single issuer-managed envelope is retained with explicit v9 classification rather than invented constituent weights. R13 re-open 2026-08-08: XT.com still advertises 'Proof of Reserves' and 1:1 backing but publishes no asset-level reserve breakdown; XSC tooling remains limited and no current collateral weights were located.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Pharos reserve row retained as an issuer-managed placeholder; the reviewed source establishes the historical XTDao design but not a current composition snapshot.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The sole issuer-managed reserve row has no current, independently verifiable collateral identity or weight.

notices.title: Non-indexed issuance chain
notices.message: XTUSD primarily circulates on XSC, which is not EVM-indexed by Pharos. No on-chain contract is stored; supply and metadata are supplemented by external sources only.

notices.title: Redemption backstop not modeled
notices.message: XTUSD is tracked from market and issuer metadata, but Pharos has not source-reviewed a public holder redemption route for backstop scoring.

mintAuthority.summary: XTUSD is minted by a live MakerDAO DSS-style CDP system on XSC: users draw Vat credit against Wrapped XT (ilk XT-A) and the DaiJoin adapter 0xa57cde0585010aa1bcfadb3bf6f3445349bb98ab, the sole ward on the token, mints on exit. The 1,000,000,000 XTUSD per-collateral debt ceiling matches the issuer announcement and is effectively frozen because the deployer was revoked from every ward set and the only Vat wards are non-governance system contracts. The token and all system contracts are non-proxy with no upgrade path.

controls.label: XTDao DaiJoin (sole XTUSD ward, live)
controls.capDescription: Mints XTUSD on user exit against Vat dai drawn on collateral; bounded by the Vat ilk XT-A line of 1e54 rad (1,000,000,000 XTUSD) and the global Line of about 1.456e54 rad. No reviewed function on a current Vat ward can raise these ceilings, so the cap is effectively frozen.
controls.evidence: At XSC block 47,838,017 (datarpc1.xsc.pub): token.wards(0xa57cde05...) = 1 and this contract's dai() = the XTUSD token 0x1a6131eaf7edd96afa10fc75b0d79dd814d19ed0, vat() = 0xf9d4810f1b140d869d2f92ca8da1755ea55e786b, live() = 1. Every other tested address (deployer 0xE8864ba6..., owner EOA 0x2571CC82..., DSProxy 0x34ed2cdd..., manager 0x5611e8f2..., GemJoin 0xdec7d8fe..., Jug 0x8276a38e...) has token.wards = 0, and a simulated mint(address,uint256) from each reverts XTUSD/not-authorized. Token Transfer(0x0 -> user) events across the xscscan history coincide with DaiJoin-style CDP exits.

controls.label: XTDao Vat (CDP debt engine, live)
controls.capDescription: Holds the XT-A debt ceiling (line = 1e54 rad) and global Line (~1.456e54 rad). Only Vat wards can file new ceilings or rely new adapters; the current wards are the Jug and the XT-A GemJoin, neither of which exposes such a call, and the deployer was revoked, so parameter governance is effectively frozen.
controls.evidence: At XSC block 47,838,017: live() = 1; wards(Jug 0x8276a38e...) = 1, wards(GemJoin 0xdec7d8fe...) = 1, wards(deployer 0xE8864ba6...) = 0 and 0 for the CDP manager, DaiJoin, DSProxy, and 0x2571CC82 EOA. ilks('XT-A') = Art 4,325,685.43, rate 1.1097 ray, spot 3.478 ray, line 1e54 rad, dust 1e43 rad; Line() ~= 1.456e54 rad. A replay of a 2022 user mint calldata reverts Vat/not-safe (position would breach collateralization), confirming the frob path is live.

controls.label: XTDao GemJoin XT-A (Wrapped XT collateral adapter)
controls.capDescription: Custodies WXT collateral for ilk XT-A and holds a Vat ward for collateral accounting (slip); it cannot mint XTUSD and exposes no ceiling-raising call.
controls.evidence: At XSC block 47,838,017: vat() = the XTDao Vat, gem() = Wrapped XT 0x4b681a704664ce482c45ec16ac9ecc9b121fb037 (name 'Wrapped XT', symbol 'WXT'), ilk() = 'XT-A', live() = 1, and it is a Vat ward.

controls.label: XTDao Jug (stability-fee module, Vat ward)
controls.capDescription: Accumulates the XT-A stability fee into Vat-internal dai owed to the vow; as a Vat ward it can alter system accounting but cannot directly mint XTUSD or raise the debt ceiling.
controls.evidence: At XSC block 47,838,017: 2,450-byte non-proxy contract whose vow() = 0x73c190d6be81bbe3cbe96bb83d8ab66f1c645160; bytecode exposes file/rely/wards but no ceiling-raising path to the Vat's line; it is a live Vat ward.

review.evidence: 2026-07-27 re-review (supersedes the 2026-07-20 unresolved review): the previously missing block explorer exists at xscscan.pub with a public API (api.xscscan.pub), and the XTDao system is a MakerDAO DSS fork whose contracts are all readable via datarpc1.xsc.pub at block 47,838,017. The XTUSD token 0x1a6131eaf7edd96afa10fc75b0d79dd814d19ed0 (3,991-byte non-proxy, EIP-1967 impl slot zero) reverts mint(address,uint256) with XTUSD/not-authorized from every tested non-ward; token.wards() returns 1 only for the DaiJoin 0xa57cde0585010aa1bcfadb3bf6f3445349bb98ab (dai() = token, vat() = 0xf9d4810f1b140d869d2f92ca8da1755ea55e786b, live() = 1) and 0 for the deployer 0xE8864ba6b3A6e2f5104A0ECFFd90E2C9fd2cb4Dc and every other contract observed across the system's xscscan transaction history. The Vat (live) has exactly the Jug 0x8276a38e... and GemJoin 0xdec7d8fe... as wards among tested system contracts, with the deployer revoked; ilks('XT-A').line = 1e54 rad and Line() ~= 1.456e54 rad, matching the issuer's announced 1,000,000,000 XTUSD per-collateral supply design, and neither Vat ward exposes a call that could raise the ceilings. The token ward set is effectively frozen because its sole ward (DaiJoin) contains no path to call rely on the token. The CDP manager 0x5611e8f241a6fd545b642dff90c6ad8c68f89b99 and user DSProxies (e.g. 0x34ed2cdd..., owner-gated by ds-auth) are user entry points, not mint authorities. Confidence is capped at manual-review because DSS ward mappings cannot be enumerated by direct reads: every ward candidate visible in four years of system transactions was probed and the deployer revoke was verified, but a never-used ward granted at setup cannot be excluded by this method. M-2 evidence binding 2026-08-08: reconciliation continuous is structural - at XSC block 47,838,017 the token's only mint ward is the DaiJoin bound to the sourced Vat (MakerDAO DSS fork), so every mint passes through vault collateral accounting; supply reconciles against locked collateral by construction. This binds the mint mechanism only - the exchange's own PoR page publishes no data (recorded separately on the proofOfReserves record).
